media.caption: Muhammad Baqir’s Iranian case is dated 1204 AH/1789 CE. These views show outer birds and flowers, a mirror and fitted dressing storage. The catalogue also describes an inner-lid courtly gathering, which these photographs do not show. No secure Shiraz workshop, purchaser or actual depicted event is established.
